thread:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated tail latency and streaming stalls observed in prod-eu /v1/stream generate calls  p95 > 2s, p99 > 7s, streaming-stall-rate up 1.8% over 5m.

oncall: I'm taking this. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.

alice (eng-runtime): I'm seeing a correlated rise in preproc CPU on eu-preproc-1/2/3. Start time ~1745031500. Influx shows template-parse-duration spikes.

ingest-bot: Note: ~1745031200 there was a small spike of large tool schema uploads via API-key tenant-332 (size ~140KB).

dmitri (eng-ml): Context: We shipped template-preproc v2.3 with an opt-in JSON-mode for tool-schema resolution last week. JSON-mode eagerly resolves nested schemas for validation. Might be the culprit.

carol (eng-sre): Dash: https://dash.redwood/streams/prod-eu?window=15m  streaming emissions show token guts stuck between tokenization and emit for ~200-600ms per request, multiple sequential requests cause backlog.

sam (product): Any evidence customers are timing out?

mike (support): Two customers reported mid-stream stalls and one timed out at 30s. All in EU. Raising priority to High.

alice (eng-runtime): Reproduced with a test harness: request combining a ~120KB tool schema + complex prompt template in JSON-mode results in template hydration + schema resolution taking ~1.3s before the first token emits. Without JSON-mode it's ~80ms.

oncall: Immediate mitigation options: a) Rollback JSON-mode toggle for prod-eu b) Rate-limit or block large tool schema uploads c) Scale preproc horizontally d) Enable streaming fallback to text-mode for affected tenants. Which is fastest?

carol (eng-sre): Fastest is toggle off. We can patch config in <2m. Scaling will help but takes longer. We should also add a temporary ingress rule to reject schema uploads >120KB for EU region until fix.

dmitri (eng-ml): Confirmed: JSON-mode eager-resolve complexity is near O(n * depth) for nested tool schemas; worst-case content triggers full traversal and validation. We need a lazy/resolution-on-demand approach.

alice (eng-runtime): Proposed immediate steps: 1) PATCH console config prod-eu: {"enable_json_toolmode":false} 2) Scale preproc +1 replica 3) Add transient ingress rule to reject >100KB schema uploads 4) Turn on prefix-KV caching for streaming keys to reduce duplicate parse.

oncall: Execute step 1 and 3 now. Carol, can you push the config?

carol (eng-sre): Pushing config patch: `PATCH /admin/configs/prod-eu {"enable_json_toolmode":false}` -> 202 accepted. Deploying ingress rule for schema size via WAF: size_limit=100KB -> applied.

incident-bot: Config change propagated to edges (1745032165). WAF rule applied (1745032180).

alice (eng-runtime): K8s scale triggered: `kubectl scale deploy preproc --replicas=6 -n prod-eu` -> scaling started.

mike (support): Customer B verified stream resumed after config toggle. Customer A still saw 1 partial stall but overall improved.

carol (eng-sre): Metrics update: p95 dropped 2.1s -> 0.7s, p99 down to 1.8s within 4m. Error-rate trending down to baseline.

dmitri (eng-ml): Root cause analysis: v2.3's JSON-mode added SchemaResolver.eagerResolveAll() during template compile which walks full tool tree and resolves references for every request. Large nested schemas cause CPU spikes and block preproc worker threads. Also observed a copy-on-write overhead in tokenizer buffer during template hydration which exacerbates tail latency.

alice (eng-runtime): Collected flamegraphs and heap snapshots; hotspots in SchemaResolver.resolveAll and TokenBuffer.copyAndInsert(). Patch idea: switch to streaming JSON parse with incremental node construction and memoize resolved schema fragments per-tenant. Also avoid copying token buffer until first nontrivial edit.

sam (product): We need customer comms. Mike, please notify impacted tenants that a temporary toggle was applied and we're building a permanent fix.

mike (support): Drafting: "We applied a temporary configuration to mitigate streaming stalls in EU. Engineering is working on a targeted fix for template parsing behavior. No further action required from you." Sending now.

oncall: Follow-ups: 1) PR to revert eager resolve and implement streaming parse (alice + dmitri) 2) Add alert: preproc CPU > 70% and streaming stall rate > 1% 3) Add telemetry: template-parse-duration histogram, schema-upload-size histogram 4) Update runbook with JSON-mode toggle steps and WAF mitigation.

dmitri (eng-ml): I'll implement lazy-resolve and a memo cache per-tenant for schema nodes. Benchmarks locally: expected 5-10x speedup for common prompt patterns, and 20x for large worst-case schemas.

alice (eng-runtime): Hotfix PR opened #4754. Includes revert of eagerResolve, streaming-json parser, and added unit tests for >200KB schema. Requesting review from dmitri and carol.

carol (eng-sre): Also recommend a short-term traffic canary when we deploy fix: 10% traffic for 30 minutes, monitor token emission rate and p99.

incident-bot: Oncall handoff in 40m. Please ensure runbook is updated.

sam (product): Once merged, coordinate canary plus customer notice that root cause fix is deployed.

mike (support): Customers notified. No escalations.

alice (eng-runtime): Adding logs for template sizes >50KB and sampling for stacktraces when parse-duration >500ms. Will revert verbose logs after triage.

carol (eng-sre): Metrics stable for 25m, p95/p99 within SLO. Closing incident but leaving follow-ups assigned.

oncall: Thanks all. Follow-ups assigned to PR owners and SRE for alerts. Filing brief incident report in postmortems. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (1745035700)  duration 60m, severity: high, impact: streaming stalls and customer timeouts in EU region.
